name: Kale Caesar Burger Salad with Fresh Tomatoes & Parmesan
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince garlic; mince anchovy fillets. Divide both evenly between two large bowls; set one bowl aside.
Add beef, salt, and pepper to the first bowl with garlic and anchovy; use your hands to thoroughly combine. Using a ¼-cup measure, form into equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Zest and juice lemon into the second bowl with garlic and anchovy. Add mayo and whisk to combine the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, place burger patties on the grill and cook, undisturbed, for 4 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 2-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
To serve, divide salad between plates; top with burger patties and Parmesan. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
